summary.intent: Resolve final round of automated PR review comments from Copilot and CodeRabbit on PR #392, then fix a release gate gap where non-release PRs (e.g. `test:` commits) could merge to main without E2E verification.
summary.outcome: All 3 review comments on PR #392 were fixed and resolved. PR #394 was merged introducing a unified `ci-e2e.yml` orchestrator with path-based change detection, a retrigger mechanism for the release gate after E2E completes on main, and a renamed `web-e2e.yml`. Multiple rounds of bot reviews on PR #394 were also resolved.

repo: The release gate auto-passes with 'Not a release PR' for non-release-please branches, making it a no-op gate for feature/test PRs despite being a required check.
`test:` commits do not trigger release-please to update the release PR, so the release gate can go stale and allow merging without re-verifying latest E2E.
Desktop E2E previously had its own `dorny/paths-filter` change detection inside `desktop-e2e.yml`; web E2E had none.
Committed fixture files live in `tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/` — `createTestMediaFile`, `createTestImageFile`, etc. were at risk of overwriting them during cleanup if a test used a matching name.
The repo uses `dorny/paths-filter` for change detection and `workflow_call` for reusable workflows, consistent with the desktop-e2e pattern.
`apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock` does not exist; the root `Cargo.lock` covers all Rust workspace crates.
The `vars` context is automatically available in reusable `workflow_call` workflows from the calling repository.

code.finding: Missing guard: if the `name` argument matched the source fixture filename, cleanup would delete a committed fixture. Added `COMMITTED_FIXTURES` set guard to all four create helpers.
Was missing the `faro_enabled: true` metadata field required by the schema.
Missing `page.isClosed()` guard before `page.evaluate()` in teardown — calling evaluate on a closed page throws.
Need `fetch-depth: 0` for `dorny/paths-filter` to access the `before` SHA for proper diff; also need all-zero SHA guard for branch creation events.
Using `// empty` in jq on a null value produces empty string, causing parse errors downstream; desktop patterns were also out of sync with ci-e2e.yml path list.

workflow: Polling for bot reviews with background `sleep` + `gh api graphql` is fragile and verbose; CodeRabbit has quota cooldowns (~23 min) that must be waited out.
When `gh run rerun` re-runs a workflow, `GITHUB_SHA` is the original stale commit, not current main — diffs must use `origin/main` instead of `HEAD`.
Outside-diff-range review comments are not returned by the GraphQL `reviewThreads` query; they must be fetched via the REST reviews API and handled separately.
Renaming a workflow file requires updating all `uses:` and polling references in ci-e2e.yml, tag-staging.yml, and release-gate.yml.

friction: CodeRabbit was rate-limited for ~23 minutes, requiring extensive polling (20+ background tasks) before its review arrived.

The user's original request was misunderstood twice — the release gate issue was initially diagnosed as 'feature PRs not gating on E2E' when the real problem was 'stale green checks on release-please PRs after test: commits land on main'.
An incorrect PR (#393) was created and had to be closed before the correct fix was implemented in #394.
Outside-diff-range comments are invisible to the GraphQL `reviewThreads` query, requiring a separate REST API call to discover them.
Several `gh api` reply calls hit network timeouts and had to be retried.
open_items: Verify the `retrigger-release-gate` mechanism works end-to-end in a real scenario where a `test:` commit lands after the release gate last ran.
The release gate still auto-passes for non-release PRs that don't touch web/desktop paths — consider whether all PRs should require some form of CI gate.
Web E2E timeout was bumped to 20 minutes; monitor whether tests still exceed this and investigate root causes if so.
